title: Sweden's Far-Right Gambit and the Inflation Gap · 14 Sep
keywords: Sweden Democrats, Swedish election, coalition government, far-right Europe, Sweden inflation, cost of living, CPI Sweden, Ulf Kristersson, Swedish politics, EU migration policy, Eurostat, household finances, centre-right coalition
notes: Sweden faces a defining moment as voters and policymakers wrestle with two overlapping crises: whether the far-right Sweden Democrats will cross from parliamentary kingmakers into full governing partners, and whether falling inflation figures translate into genuine relief for households still paying elevated prices. Both questions expose a widening gap between official framing and lived experience. The outcome of each will shape Sweden's political identity and economic trajectory for years to come.
